text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We won, Trainer. I think... that was a
great race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I had a lot of fun, and I'm certain the
folks back
home would be proud.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...All that intense running has left me
abnormally
hungry, though.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...All that intense running has left me
abnormally
hungry, though.
choice_data_list: A real feast today, isn't it!
Let's give it everything we've got next time too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean it? In that case, I think I'll
have
sukiyaki, sushi, and a massive
serving of carrots.
And then after that...
choice_data_list: Let's give it everything we've got next time too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. Just thinking about it makes me
hungrier...
and dizzy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh no. I think I'm going to collapse...
Trainer, let's
go eat right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course. I give it my all in every race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Winning wouldn't be any fun if I wasn't
serious.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Once my stomach's full, it's back to
training. Let's
go!
